patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient presents with a complaint of severe vulvar itching that has been gradually worsening over the course of the past year. She has attempted to use over-the-counter lubricants for relief with no substantial improvement. She reports severe pain during vaginal intercourse that has recently led to cessation of sexual activity.

Secondary_Symptoms: Use of over-the-counter lubricants with no relief

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Diet-controlled type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypertension treated with hydrochlorothiazide, menopause occurred at 52 years of age.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Sexually active with her husband until recently due to discomfort.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies urinary symptoms, abnormal vaginal discharge, or rectal symptoms.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with chronic vulvar itching and discomfort.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, I’m a 60-year-old woman, and for the past year I’ve had gradually worsening, severe itching of my vulva. I’ve tried over-the-counter lubricants, but they haven’t helped much, and intercourse has become extremely painful so I’ve stopped having sex.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you often find yourself needing to rush to the bathroom to urinate, or feeling like you can't hold your urine for a short period of time?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have to rush to urinate, and I don’t feel like I can’t hold my urine—I haven’t noticed any urinary trouble.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any firm lumps or areas in your breasts that feel different from the rest of your breast tissue?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any firm lumps or any areas in my breasts that feel different from the rest of the tissue. My main issue has been the severe itching and the pain during intercourse.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any small, smooth bumps on your skin that feel firm to the touch?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any small, smooth bumps on my skin that feel firm to the touch. It’s mainly the severe vulvar itching that’s been steadily worsening, and the pain with intercourse.”

turns.doctor_question: I've been reviewing your symptoms, and I want to ask: Have you been feeling like you just can't cool down or catch your breath, even when you're resting in a cool place?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t felt overheated or like I can’t catch my breath at rest, and I don’t notice any trouble cooling down. It’s mainly the severe vulvar itching and the pain during intercourse that’s been getting worse over the past year.”

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling lately? Have you been experiencing a lot of stress or anxiety in your daily life?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I wouldn’t say I’ve been unusually stressed or anxious day to day. My mood has been more affected by the discomfort itself—especially the worsening itching and the pain during intercourse.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a sensation of needing to scratch lately, either all over your body or in specific areas?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, the itching is mostly around my vulvar area—it feels relentless and makes me feel like I need to scratch, but I don’t really have the same kind of itching all over my body. It’s been gradually getting worse over the past year, and it’s causing significant discomfort day to day.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions on your arms, particularly along the veins?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or lesions on my arms, including along the veins. My problems are mainly localized to the vulvar area with the severe itching and pain during intercourse.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you ever have trouble finding the right words when you're talking, like they're stuck just out of reach?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had trouble finding the right words or feeling like my speech is off—my issues are mainly the relentless vulvar itching and the pain with intercourse. I’m not noticing any other neurological or whole-body symptoms.”

turns.doctor_question: I'm here to help figure out what's going on with your health. Can you tell me if you've noticed any stiffness or inflexibility in your muscles, like it's hard to move or relax certain parts of your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any muscle stiffness or trouble moving or relaxing specific parts of my body. My main concern is the relentless vulvar itching and the pain during intercourse, which has been steadily worsening over the past year.”

turns.doctor_question: How are you feeling today? Have you been feeling unusually sleepy or drowsy lately, even when you've had a good night's rest?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I feel mostly like my usual self aside from the discomfort—no unusual sleepiness or drowsiness, and I’ve been getting a normal amount of rest. The main thing affecting me day to day is the relentless vulvar itching and the pain with intercourse.”

turns.doctor_question: How are your legs feeling in terms of temperature? Do they feel warm or cold to you?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, my legs feel normal to me—neither unusually warm nor unusually cold. My main problem is still the severe vulvar itching and the pain with intercourse.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you find that you're coughing up mucus or phlegm when you cough?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have coughing or mucus/phlegm issues. My only ongoing problem is the severe itching of my vulvar area and the pain during intercourse that’s been gradually worsening over the past year.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rough, scaly patches on your skin lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rough, scaly patches on my skin—my symptoms are mainly localized to the vulvar area with severe itching, and it’s also painful during intercourse. There isn’t anything else unusual on the surrounding skin that I can describe as scaly.”
